extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: An itemized bill is a statement that lists all healthcare services provided to a patient. A statement that lists groups of services or items, such as those reported by revenue codes, is not considered to be an itemized bill because revenue codes are categorical and do not describe exact services and items provided. This policy outlines Humana's expectation that an itemized bill be made available to Humana upon request.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana reserves the right to request itemized bills, prior to payment when necessary, in order to confirm proper billing, as supported by Section 1815(a) and Section 1833(e) of the Social Security Act, Section 422.214(a)(2) of Title 42 of the Code of Federal Regulations, contract provisions and other relevant guidance. Any improper billing may result in a reduction or denial of payment for specific charges.
